summary:
Revised Master Implementation Plan (Revision 4) for the Universal Medical & Polyclinic Platform (Category 9) in Atrium ERP & CRM.
Purged specialty-specific dental odontogram charting to ensure 100% universal applicability across all medical institutions (polyclinics, health centers, day hospitals, multi-specialty group practices, and outpatient clinics).
Maintains universal clinical excellence:
- Doctor Ordonnance Personalization Studio (A5/A4, Pre-printed Paper mode, custom letterhead, digital cachet, verification QR)
- Multi-Practitioner Polyclinic & Cabinet Routing
- Multi-Doctor Time-Slot Agenda & Conflict-Free Booking
- Live Fullscreen Waiting Room TV Display Mode with Web Audio API synthetic chime
- Clinical EHR 360° with Slide-Over Drawer (UniversalDataCollection, longitudinal timeline, SVG biometric curves, ALD passport)
- Real-time Allergy & Drug Contraindication Safety Engine
- Diagnostic Lab & Radiology Imaging Vault with physiological reference ranges and abnormal flags
- Official Legal Medical Certificates Engine (Arrêt de travail CNAS, aptitude, ITT, lettre d'orientation)
- Algerian Social Security (CNAS / CASNOS / Carte Chifa / Tiers-Payant 80%/100%, NGAP cotations, bordereau télétransmission)
- Practitioner Commission Splits & Secretary Daily Cash Drawer Closure
- Clinic Consumables Auto-Depletion per medical act
Strictly follows Atrium's desktop UI tokens (Pod trays #F8F9FA, dark espresso #1F1D1B, AtriumButton #C4785A, UniversalDataCollection, Seek, kinetic LabelSelect, zero-pill metadata discipline).
